parts:
Hi all,

Thanks to Tim Bowles for a great session today on multivariate stats with vegan!  You'll find the screencast, Tim's slides, and a download link  for all the code used today here: http://www.noamross.net/blog/2014/12/9/bowles-vegan.html

This was the last D-RUG meeting for the fall quarter.  Look out for a poll for winter quarter times later this week.

Noam
